label: About
title: About Cassette Pressure Datacenter Procession
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 312 recent saved-signal files and 208 captured links, then narrowed the page to 6 source windows around @somewheresy: DEI stands for Datacenter, Electricity and Infrastructure now and @Must_be_Ash: I pay tested thousands of x402 endpoints and I'm open sourcing the whole thing..., plus 4 more. A source image from img.youtube.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Cassette Pressure Datacenter Procession: Build a cassette-pressure datacenter procession as fashion/material macro, shot in shallow macro: two huge cloudy plastic and smoky laminate surfaces collide, crossed by black oxide tape paths like bass ridges and diagonal river seams. Amber CRT apertures, dropout slits, glossy defects, toner punctures, and cropped... After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 6 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against translucent smoky cassette laminate, amber embedded apertures, and diagonal black oxide tape bands.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
